items.description: notebooks/kaggle_evaluate.ipynb, committed with outputs cleared, evaluates every checkpoint in docs/ledger.md on val and trans_val only. One parameter cell: COMMIT (the main commit to clone and pip-install trailcam at), CACHE_ARCHIVE (the default as in kaggle_train.ipynb, the packing notebook's output), CHECKPOINTS_ROOT (a private Kaggle dataset trailcam-checkpoints the user creates with the 7 .pt files, found by search under /kaggle/input as the cache code finds the archive) and ASSETS_OVERLAY_RUN (optional: the run id whose model draws the Grad-CAM overlays from assets/). It reuses the training notebook's patterns: clone at COMMIT, pip install keeping Kaggle's torch, the modules check, check_gpu, the archive unpack to local disk and the cache completeness check. Before any evaluation it checks every checkpoint's sha256 against its ledger row and refuses unknown or missing ones by run id, with counts only. Per checkpoint `python -m trailcam.evaluate.evaluate` (val, trans_val; --overlay from assets/ only if the item-8.05 photos are present, and it works when assets/ is empty), then `python -m trailcam.evaluate.attention`; per seed `python -m trailcam.evaluate.slices` with that seed's arm A and arm B checkpoints; the small CNN evaluate and attention only (keep_features=False where the API needs it). It ends by zipping /kaggle/working/eval for download and printing a short summary table, counts and scores only. Its own How to run markdown covers the user's two steps (download each of the 7 versions' .pt into one private dataset trailcam-checkpoints, and keep the original versions) and ends at which files to copy into docs/figures/ within the guard's budget. Also a section of notebooks/kaggle_look_at_data.ipynb, an eye check of real arm B crops for the user's eyes only: about 12 boxed training photos from the cache, each with its box outlined, beside 2 or 3 arm B crops drawn by trailcam/data/boxcrop.py's sampler and 1 or 2 arm A crops for contrast, titled with the class and day/night only, never a file name, with a markdown note that these outputs are for the user's eyes in the session, are cleared before commit and never go into docs/figures/ (R03, R04); no training code changes.
